newsitem.title: THAILAND: Eight Thais die in bus-truck collision.
newsitem.headline: Eight Thais die in bus-truck collision.

text.p: Eight people, including six Moslem school girls, were killed in a head-on collision between a chartered school bus and a heavy truck in southern Thailand, police said on Tuesday.
Police said the bus, on a sight-seeing excursion, crashed with the trailer truck in Hau Sai district, Nakorn Si Thammarat province, about 600 km (360 miles) south of Bangkok.
The accident on Monday night also killed the bus driver and a woman and left 25 others injured.
